cards.art: badger clawing earth at dusk near ancient trail groove
cards.lore: The bend worn into the earth over generations.
cards.name: The Necessary Motion
cards.power: Generates raw survival.

cards.art: owl perched high, wolf running below in twilight forest
cards.lore: The bad knee guards the young; the keen eye takes the high branches.
cards.name: The First Division
cards.power: Sorts the pack by utility.

cards.art: three bears carrying massive log toward setting sun
cards.lore: The day ended when there was enough.
cards.name: The Shared Burden
cards.power: Distributes daylight evenly.

cards.art: beaver gnawing branch, modern concrete dam looming behind
cards.lore: The moment "doing" became "duty".
cards.name: The Pattern
cards.power: Detaches repetition from appetite.

cards.art: fat cat napping in giant industrial gear teeth
cards.lore: The small gap between bending out of hunger and bending out of habit.
cards.name: The Not-Working
cards.power: Creates the concept of laziness.

cards.art: startled goat airborne from giant bronze bell explosion
cards.lore: The day has owners, and they are calling.
cards.name: The Monastery Bell
cards.power: Slices the sun into eight prayers.

cards.art: black crow shrieking beside belching factory smokestacks at dawn
cards.lore: Time is now currency; it is spent, not passed.
cards.name: The Factory Whistle
cards.power: Transforms prayer into industrial shifts.

cards.art: skeletal horse pulling overloaded cart under enormous full moon
cards.lore: Daylight is the only legitimate limit to availability.
cards.name: The Long Day
cards.power: Consumes all available existence.

cards.art: raccoon on podium waving '3x8' placard before rally crowd
cards.lore: A radical claim that some time belongs to the breather.
cards.name: The Hour Saved
cards.power: Reclaims exactly eight hours for "what we will."

cards.art: panicked squirrel wrestling with exploding stopwatch, gears flying
cards.lore: The future belongs to the system; the past belonged to the beast.
cards.name: The Stopwatch
cards.power: Fractures fluid movement into cold math.

cards.art: muscular bull strapped with piled anvils straining forward
cards.lore: The first manual for treating the body as a gear.
cards.name: The Optimised Body
cards.power: Quadruples the load bearing capacity of flesh.

cards.art: three mice at separate factory machines making wire and cutting pins
cards.lore: Making things without knowing how to make a thing.
cards.name: The Pin Factory
cards.power: Multiplies output by a factor of 240.

cards.art: line of different animals each holding one specialist tool in row
cards.lore: Ten beasts make forty-eight thousand fragments.
cards.name: The Division of Labour
cards.power: Severs the maker from the whole.

cards.art: sheep shearing its own wool, sucked immediately into factory vacuum pipe
cards.lore: The worker grows poorer the more wealth they produce.
cards.name: The Alienation
cards.power: Enriches the system by impoverishing the soul.

cards.art: fat pig in top hat drinking from tubes connected to exhausted mice workers
cards.lore: The factory starves if the worker keeps what they make.
cards.name: The Surplus
cards.power: Extracts the ghost from the machine.

cards.art: small colorful bird standing beside padlocked steel-framed cube, identical twin inside
cards.lore: No one can leave without ceasing to be modern.
cards.name: The Iron Cage
cards.power: Forces the calling into inescapable logic.

cards.art: docile cow lying on price-tagged supermarket shelf with barcode on flank
cards.lore: Land, coin, and sweat become goods.
cards.name: The Commodity Labour
cards.power: Puts life on a shelf with a price tag.

cards.art: fox receiving spinning gold coin in exchange for glowing swirl of energy
cards.lore: The person becomes the meat inside the hour.
cards.name: The For-Sale Hour
cards.power: Trades the part of the self that fills the time.

cards.art: cheerful frog at drafting desk sketching open-plan layout, cubicle maze behind
cards.lore: An invention designed to free you, destined to cage you.
cards.name: The Action Office
cards.power: Liberates the thinker from the typing pool.

cards.art: several stunned deer heads visible above identical grey cubicle partitions
cards.lore: A revolution mass-produced into a prison.
cards.name: The Cubicle Fence
cards.power: Shrinks the horizon to modular plastic.

cards.art: stern owl in collar holding up its own glowing brain surrounded by equations
cards.lore: Cannot be coerced; must be persuaded, motivated, included.
cards.name: The Knowledge Worker
cards.power: Deploys the mind as the means of production.

cards.art: panicked rabbit drowning under exploding pile of administrative memos and forms
cards.lore: The illusion of dignity, infinitely measurable.
cards.name: The Memo
cards.power: Replaces the physical whip with administrative paper.

cards.art: blank-faced fish in suits seated around conference table, blank projection screen
cards.lore: Where time goes to be collectively sacrificed.
cards.name: The Meeting
cards.power: Replaces the assembly belt with a conference table.

cards.art: obese toad expanding to fill entire room, smug expression, files scattered
cards.lore: It takes six weeks because six weeks were given.
cards.name: The Cascade
cards.power: Expands work to fill the allotted void.

cards.art: panicked hamster running in wheel shaped like quarterly pie chart
cards.lore: The beast shapes itself to please the analyst.
cards.name: The Quarterly
cards.power: Warps reality into three-month chunks.

cards.art: dog sprinting off cliff edge chasing mechanical rabbit decoy
cards.lore: When a measure becomes a target, truth dies.
cards.name: The Goodhart Proxy
cards.power: Destroys the underlying value of any measurement.

cards.art: elaborate spider web on chalkboard labelled with org chart titles, spider waiting below
cards.lore: The real currents are sideways and in the shadows.
cards.name: The Org Chart
cards.power: Tells a comforting fiction about how power flows.

cards.art: enormous hand shaking snow globe containing tiny ant workers at office desks
cards.lore: A periodic ritual to pretend the river changed course.
cards.name: The Reorg
cards.power: Shuffles the deck while the dealer cheats.

cards.art: snake in suit wearing smiling mask reviews rat across table, rat also masked
cards.lore: Most reviews are dishonest in both directions.
cards.name: The Performance Review
cards.power: Forces mutual dishonesty once a year.

cards.art: crow with scythe throwing 'Bottom 10%' files into trash can, bar chart behind
cards.lore: The line was drawn before you entered the room.
cards.name: The Calibration Curve
cards.power: Dooms a percentage of the pack before they begin.

cards.art: parrot in tie stamping enormous stack of forms with APPROVED stamp
cards.lore: Writing the report no one will ever read.
cards.name: The Box-Ticker
cards.power: Verifies the existence of a corporate lie.

cards.art: octopus using all eight arms to hold leaking industrial pipes together
cards.lore: Human glue for digital incompetence.
cards.name: The Duct-Taper
cards.power: Patches a glitch that should not exist.

cards.art: slow sloth in business suit gesturing vaguely at busy beehive with pointer stick
cards.lore: Supervising those who already know what to do.
cards.name: The Taskmaster
cards.power: Manages the unmanageable for no reason.

cards.art: full-fan peacock standing beside small grey pigeon carrying briefcase looking deflated
cards.lore: Existing solely to make someone else look important.
cards.name: The Flunky
cards.power: Magnifies the ego of the superior.

cards.art: two armored rhinoceroses facing each other in corporate marble lobby
cards.lore: The arms race of corporate lawyers and lobbyists.
cards.name: The Goon
cards.power: Counters the enemy's identical minion.

cards.art: giraffe neck stretched through glass office ceiling, looking at leaf on desk above
cards.lore: The modern firm calls it seniority; the guild called it survival.
cards.name: The Ladder
cards.power: Translates feudal advancement into cubicles.

cards.art: chameleon before glowing monitor displaying blank name tag, skin shifting grey
cards.lore: When asked who you are, you answer what you do.
cards.name: The Title
cards.power: Merges the core self with the corporate role.

cards.art: racing greyhound gripping its own leash in its mouth, sprinting through flames
cards.lore: The push is internal; the push is the air you breathe.
cards.name: The Achievement-Subject
cards.power: Exploits itself without external pressure.

cards.art: charred remains in office chair, intact 'World's Best Boss' mug in carbonized hand
cards.lore: You cannot stop being the one who runs.
cards.name: The Burned
cards.power: Consumes the self from the inside out.

cards.art: exhausted elephant surrounded by falling grandfather clocks in storm-grey air
cards.lore: Alienation felt in the bone, not the book.
cards.name: The Intolerable Burden
cards.power: Turns the passage of time into physical agony.

cards.art: badger with wrench repairing old engine in candlelit garage, gears gleaming
cards.lore: The carburettor answers you in a way the spreadsheet never will.
cards.name: The Mended Thing
cards.power: Defeats the hermeneutics of suspicion.

cards.art: raccoon in candlelight weaving wicker basket, focused, no phone nearby
cards.lore: The body knows the whole object.
cards.name: The Skilled Hand
cards.power: Remembers what the mind was trained to forget.

cards.art: ancient turtle carefully chiselling ornate floral pattern into dark wood box
cards.lore: A slowness the modern firm cannot tolerate.
cards.name: The Craftsman
cards.power: Cares for the work strictly for its own sake.

cards.art: line of identical ducklings on conveyor belt moving toward corporate training screen
cards.lore: We no longer apprentice; we are processed.
cards.name: The Onboarded Apprentice
cards.power: Replaces mastery with a slide deck.

cards.art: cat at computer desk, pen down, expression serene and unmoved, mug untouched
cards.lore: The structural refusal to gift the surplus.
cards.name: The Quiet Quitting
cards.power: Delivers exactly what is paid for, no more.

cards.art: panda lying completely flat on floor, vintage phone ringing nearby, ignored
cards.lore: Only by doing nothing can you be the measure of all things.
cards.name: The Lying Flat
cards.power: Denies the system its desires.

cards.art: mole in glowing crystal cave beneath grey factory, sketching with joy
cards.lore: The sanctuary of the un-alienated soul.
cards.name: The Side Project
cards.power: Harbours the work that actually matters.

cards.art: translucent owl in top hat surrounded by floating clock faces and scattered numbers
cards.lore: The productivity went somewhere, but it didn't come back to you.
cards.name: The Fifteen-Hour Illusion
cards.power: Promises a leisure that never arrives.

cards.art: snake in serpentine coil around glowing phone resting on bedroom pillow at night
cards.lore: The Bed and the Desk have merged.
cards.name: The Always-On
cards.power: Erases the boundary between dusk and dawn.

cards.art: electric blue wasps swarming into dark cave toward sleeping bear, clocks on cave wall
cards.lore: The structural unit of the new, endless workday.
cards.name: The Notification
cards.power: Invades the sanctuary of the mind at 11:47 PM.

cards.art: sheep in pyjamas chained by padlock to kitchen desk with open laptop
cards.lore: A costume the office did not know it was getting.
cards.name: The Pyjama Desk
cards.power: Camouflages the office in domestic cloth.

cards.art: iguana in Hawaiian shirt working on laptop at beach, palm trees, waves
cards.lore: You rest only to return to the work in better shape.
cards.name: The Forced Holiday
cards.power: Engineers recovery strictly to fuel more labor.

cards.art: robotic arm lit by spotlight in empty factory, human tools gathering dust
cards.lore: The replacement does not need a quarterly report.
cards.name: The Replacement
cards.power: Waits patiently to inherit your function.

cards.art: melancholy hound pressed against factory window watching automated machinery work inside
cards.lore: Surpassed by our own products, smaller than ourselves.
cards.name: The Obsolete Man
cards.power: Manifests the shame of our own slowness.

cards.art: abandoned hammer and axe covered in moss, wildflowers growing through handle, spiderwebs
cards.lore: The machine that no longer needs us.
cards.name: The Idle Tool
cards.power: Sits quietly where the worker used to stand.

cards.art: badger, fox, rabbit, owl dancing joyfully around blazing bonfire under stars
cards.lore: The part of the day that has no purpose outside itself.
cards.name: The Real Leisure
cards.power: Reclaims contemplation and festival.

title: What Work Was For: A Field Report from Before the Timesheet — Vol. I
